description: This file defines the DeviceService interface for device management operations within the Thingsboard platform, including device retrieval, saving, assignment, deletion, and querying functionalities.

classes.name: DeviceService
classes.description: Interface defining device management operations such as retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and assignment within the Thingsboard platform.
